title: Vaporwave/Synthwave
content: Apply vaporwave/synthwave retro-futuristic aesthetic. Use dark purple/black backgrounds (bg-purple-950, bg-slate-950). Add neon accent colors: hot pink (pink-500), cyan (cyan-400), purple (violet-500). Create sunset gradients (from-orange-500 via-pink-500 to-purple-600). Include retro grid perspective effect using CSS linear-gradient. Add chrome/metallic text effects with gradients. Use retro pixel or display fonts for headings. Include palm tree silhouettes, geometric shapes, or retro tech imagery. Apply scan lines or CRT effects subtly. Glowing effects on key elements.

variants.simple: Create retro-futuristic 80s aesthetic with neon colors, grids, and sunset gradients.

variants.advanced: Apply vaporwave/synthwave retro-futuristic 80s aesthetic. Color palette: deep purples (purple-950, violet-900), blacks for background; neon accents - hot pink (pink-500, #ff00ff), cyan (cyan-400, #00ffff), electric purple (violet-500). Sunset sky: gradient from-yellow-400 via-orange-500 via-pink-500 to-purple-600 for hero sections. Retro grid: perspective effect using CSS - linear-gradient creating horizontal and vertical lines, transform: perspective(500px) rotateX(60deg), animate slowly moving toward viewer. Sun element: large circle with gradient, positioned at horizon with reflection. Chrome/metallic text: gradient text (bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-100 via-gray-400 to-gray-100 bg-clip-text) with text-shadow for 3D effect. Typography: retro display fonts (Outrun, Lazer84 style), or use Orbitron, Audiowide from Google Fonts. Glowing effects: multiple box-shadows in neon colors (shadow-[0_0_10px_#ff00ff,0_0_20px_#ff00ff,0_0_40px_#ff00ff]). Scan lines: pseudo-element overlay with repeating-linear-gradient (1px transparent, 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)). Decorative elements: geometric shapes, palm tree silhouettes (SVG), retro tech imagery, Greek statues. Audio visualizer bars, VHS tracking lines for authenticity. Performance: heavy effects can be GPU-intensive, provide reduced-motion fallback. Accessibility: ensure text remains readable over busy backgrounds, add solid color fallback behind text.
